items.problem: The shared telemetry runs rule says the k-th run of a commit starts with `--random-base <k>` "so the two commits play the same worlds run for run", but the same rule counts the replacing runs on per commit and replaces only the runs of a commit that did not reach a step. When run 2 of this commit does not reach a step and the three baseline runs do, this commit's kept runs are random bases 1, 3, 4 and the baseline's are 1, 2, 3, so the mean and spread of each metric are taken over different worlds. `sideRuns` (tools/src/commands/loop/lib/shared-telemetry.ts:60-74) implements exactly this rule, and evaluate.test.ts:1536 asserts bases 1 to 5 for one commit beside 1 to 3 for the other. The rule existed before this commit range (3417ebc); fixing it means changing the defining document (e.g. replacing by world on both commits, or comparing only the worlds that both commits reached)

`requireReference` fails a missing `records/setup/reference/reference.md` with only `records/setup/reference/reference.md is missing`. ogw.md `## loop evaluate` says that then the tool prints the missing files and how to put them there, and skills/game-loop/SKILL.md step 3 has the lead agent tell the human that output; the message for missing videos says how to put them there, the message for a missing `reference.md` does not (unchanged since before the commit range)
